Name: Small Crow Coast Farm
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=4](Small Version of my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48954]Crow Coast Farm[/url])[/size]

[size=4]The farm has wild crows that will spawn around the farm(They have no effect on crops).

The [b]Starter Gift [/b]gives 1 Coffee Bean and 1 Crow Tamer which is a powerful scarecrow that's recipe is unlocked at level 9 Farming.

You can refill your [b]watering can[/b] in the water buckets close to the farmhouse for easier watering!

[b]Config Options[/b]:[/size]
[list]
[*][size=4]The Crow Statue that replaces the normal warp statue can be reverted[/size][/*]
[*][size=4]Crow Spawns can be turned off or on[/size][/*]
[/list][size=4]Endorsements are very appreciated![/size]

Downloads.Description: Added a ladder near the bottom right of the beach, and changed the opossum location slightly + spawn rate increase
